Living on the top floor, with unobstructed views, excellent sun exposure and superior quality finishes is a rare privilege. This magnificent 2 bedroom flat brings together comfort, modernity and energy efficiency in one of the most valued areas of Coimbra.

With 110 m² of floor space, it stands out for the natural light present in all rooms and for its panoramic view over the Choupal National Forest and the Coimbra Forum, providing a quiet and exclusive environment.

The large social area integrates the living room and kitchen in an open space concept, creating a modern and welcoming space, ideal for family and social life. The kitchen is fully equipped with induction hob, electric oven, microwave and refrigerator.

The private area consists of two bedrooms with built-in wardrobes, one of which is a comfortable suite with a private bathroom and balcony. The second bedroom is supported by a full bathroom, ensuring full functionality for the family or to receive visitors.

Property Highlights:

 Top floor with lift

This flat offers the perfect balance between comfort, safety and quality of construction, being ideal for those looking for a modern, bright home with unique views over the city.
